claims.object_text: plays fundamental roles in forebrain development, from the timing of neurogenesis to the patterning of the cerebral cortex
claims.quote: Forkhead Box G1 (FOXG1) is one of the master regulators that play fundamental roles in forebrain development; from the timing of neurogenesis, to the patterning of the cerebral cortex.

claims.object_text: FOXG1 syndrome (congenital form of Rett syndrome)
claims.quote: Mutations in the FOXG1 gene cause a rare neurodevelopmental disorder called FOXG1 syndrome, also known as congenital form of Rett syndrome.

Patients presenting with FOXG1 syndrome manifest a spectrum of phenotypes, ranging from severe cognitive dysfunction and microcephaly to social withdrawal and communication deficits, with varying severities.
